meta.title: Fish quality checks and ISO certificates
meta.description: Every order is checked against the agreed specification before the boxes are closed. We hold ISO certificates, certified by TÜV AUSTRIA.

hero.title: Quality checked against your specification
hero.intro: We inspect every order before the boxes are closed, against the species, weight grade, packing and labels agreed with you.
hero.imageAlt: Whole fresh fish on crushed ice seen from above
hero.secondary: See how we pack and ship

practice.title: From washing to inspection
practice.intro: At our plant in Motobas we wash, ice, grade, pack and inspect the fish. Inspection is the last stage before shipment.
practice.link: See all five stages, from farming to export

certs.title: ISO certificates for our management systems
certs.statement: We hold ISO certificates, certified by TÜV AUSTRIA.
certs.documents: For the food-safety and health documents your market requires, our export team confirms what travels with each shipment before you order.

faq.title: Questions from procurement and quality teams
faq.q1: Which ISO standards do you hold?
faq.a1: We hold ISO 9001:2015 for quality management, ISO 14001:2015 for environmental management and ISO 45001:2018 for occupational health and safety, certified by TÜV AUSTRIA.
